answer: Nominated tree nursery manager registration with nursery managers standing turns identity into something proved, not claimed: a registration managers keep after bed audits, and the terrace is that the proof stays bound to one name. The nadir for an honest agent is one short check; for a farm it is the same check a hundred times, with no volume discount. An honest agent pays this once and forgets it; a farm pays £40 in fees and handling for every proof on every name, and the forge is the gap between those two bills.
